checks.name: EnabledClientHasMemberOwner
checks.property: An enabled developer client belongs to someone with an active chapter membership.
checks.harm: Someone who left or was removed from every chapter keeps a working OAuth client that skips consent, so people who sign in through it hand over their identity and chapter claims.

checks.name: EnabledClientHasMemberOwnerWhenSerial
checks.property: When requests do not overlap, an enabled developer client belongs to someone with an active chapter membership.
checks.harm: Someone who left or was removed from every chapter keeps a working OAuth client that skips consent, so people who sign in through it hand over their identity and chapter claims.

checks.name: RevokedTokenStaysDead
checks.property: When developer-console requests do not overlap anything, a token issued before its client's owner lost membership never works again.
checks.harm: A grant that was revoked when the client's owner lost membership works again without the end user authorizing again.

checks.name: RevokedTokenStaysDeadWhenSerial
checks.property: When requests and sign-ins do not overlap, a token issued before its client's owner lost membership never works again.
checks.harm: A grant that was revoked when the client's owner lost membership works again without the end user authorizing again.
